_comment: `first.js` and `second.js` are the only ESM modules that `import defer` wraps. Each one is a root that imports only CommonJS modules. The wrapper declaration of `a.cjs` goes in the wrapper of `first.js`, and the wrapper declaration of `b.cjs` goes in the wrapper of `second.js`. `shared.cjs` stays at the top level, because both roots import it.
